final: SELECT AVG(film_count) AS average_count, AVG(film_count - overall_avg) AS average_excess FROM (SELECT rating, COUNT(DISTINCT film.film_id) AS film_count FROM film JOIN inventory ON inventory.film_id = film.film_id JOIN rental ON rental.inventory_id = inventory.inventory_id GROUP BY rating) AS rating_counts CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(film_count) AS overall_avg FROM (SELECT rating, COUNT(DISTINCT film.film_id) AS film_count FROM film JOIN inventory ON inventory.film_id = film.film_id JOIN rental ON rental.inventory_id = inventory.inventory_id GROUP BY rating) AS all_rating_counts) AS overall WHERE film_count > overall_avg
